title: langgraph-cli==0.4.32
summary: Changes since cli==0.4.31 feat(cli): place self-hosted deployments on a listener ( #9056 ) feat(cli): clarify agent flags and support env defaults ( #9063 ) feat(cli): Update langgraph deploy command to use agent_id and environment args ( #9055 ) feat(cli): add --image-uri flag for self-hosted deployments ( #8482 ) fix(cli): remediate AnyIO vulnerabilities in example lockfiles ( #9022 ) chore(deps): bump anyio from 4
body:
Changes since cli==0.4.31

- feat(cli): place self-hosted deployments on a listener ( #9056 )

- feat(cli): clarify agent flags and support env defaults ( #9063 )

- feat(cli): Update langgraph deploy command to use agent_id and environment args ( #9055 )

- feat(cli): add --image-uri flag for self-hosted deployments ( #8482 )

- fix(cli): remediate AnyIO vulnerabilities in example lockfiles ( #9022 )

- chore(deps): bump anyio from 4.13.0 to 4.14.2 in /libs/cli ( #8998 )

- chore(deps): fix vulnerable dev dependencies ( #8449 )

- chore(deps): bump httpx2 from 2.10.0 to 2.12.0 in /libs/cli ( #8863 )

- chore(deps): bump js-yaml from 4.3.1 to 4.3.2 in /libs/cli/js-monorepo-example ( #8867 )

- chore(deps): bump httpcore2 from 2.5.0 to 2.10.0 in /libs/cli ( #8864 )

- fix(cli): clarify missing deploy config ( #8854 )

- chore(deps): bump browserslist from 4.28.1 to 4.28.8 in /libs/cli/js-examples ( #8797 )

- chore(deps): bump @humanfs/node from 0.16.7 to 0.16.8 in /libs/cli/js-examples ( #8798 )

- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/cli with 6 updates ( #8778 )

- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/cli/js-monorepo-example with 6 updates ( #8776 )

- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/cli/js-examples with 6 updates ( #8775 )

- chore(deps): bump langgraph-checkpoint-postgres from 3.0.5 to 3.1.1 in /libs/cli/uv-examples/monorepo in the uv group across 1 directory ( #8646 )

- chore: enforce PLC0415 in tests for the remaining packages ( #8547 )

- chore: enable RUF100 and clear unused noqa directives ( #8546 )

- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/cli/js-examples with 8 updates ( #8492 )

- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/cli/js-monorepo-example with 8 updates ( #8489 )

- chore(deps-dev): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/cli with 4 updates ( #8495 )

- chore(deps-dev): bump typescript from 6.0.3 to 7.0.2 in /libs/cli/js-monorepo-example in the major group ( #8496 )

- chore(deps-dev): bump typescript from 6.0.3 to 7.0.2 in /libs/cli/js-examples in the major group ( #8498 )

- chore(deps): bump cryptography from 48.0.1 to 50.0.0 in /libs/cli ( #8529 )

- chore(deps): bump js-yaml from 4.2.0 to 4.3.0 in /libs/cli/js-monorepo-example ( #8438 )

- chore(deps): bump setuptools from 82.0.1 to 83.0.0 in /libs/cli ( #8434 )
